<ElMarroqui> re: **@justindrake**
> What about modexp? It's currently by far the worst prover killer and it feels like we could do some non-deterministic magic with it.
Here is a PR in gnark where I tried to do hinted modexp https://github.com/Consensys/gnark/pull/1506
*tl;dr* it doesn't work systematically because the modulus is not necessarily a prime.
